name: PAX Global Technology Limited
summary: PAX Global Technology Limited, an investment holding company, develops and sells electronic funds transfer point-of-sale products in Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, the United States, and Italy. The company offers e-payment terminal products that include android smart e-payment solutions, unattended solutions, classic e-payment solutions, commercial EPOS solution, and other products; android smartPOS; classic POS; and android smart tablet.
